A full 10-step ramp per hue is not in the public CSS.

F2.evidence: light.background.page #f6f5f9, canvas #ffffff, surface (raised) #ffffff, overlay #ffffff, sunken, and overlay.scrim from --colors-ds-semantic-overlay-scrim. The same roles exist under dark from /pro.

F3.evidence: light.text.primary #101114, secondary #686b82, muted #9497a9, disabled, inverse, on-accent #ffffff, link #7132f5. Dark remaps the same roles on /pro.

F4.evidence: light.border.default and subtle (rgba(104, 107, 130, 0.161)), strong #686b82, focus #7132f5. Measured focus-visible on nav Sign up is a 2px solid #7132f5 outline.

F8.evidence: Kraken-Brand, Kraken-Product and Kraken-Mono with IBM Plex fallbacks. core.typography holds display1-4, heading1-6, body1-4, label1-3, caption1-2, editorial1, brand1, bodyMono1 and heroNumber. The home h1 measured Kraken-Brand 48px/56px weight 400.

F9.evidence: core.spacing is a derived 4px scale (4 through the measured 8, 12 and 16 button paddings). Kraken does not publish a space scale as custom properties. Declared component gaps (--spacing-ds-radio-*, checkbox gaps) are measured separately.

F10.evidence: --border-radius-ds-0 through 8 (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 32px) plus the 9999px round step, and component radii (button-md 12px, card 12px, dialog 20px). Borders are the semantic border roles plus the 1px field border measured on the sign-up email input.

F14.evidence: Desktop 1440 and phone 390 are captured, header is 64px, the home hero title measures 651px wide. No published grid-column or z-index scale was extracted. Search and the phone menu are overlays in the screenshots, not a z-index token set.
